jobs.name: Day training isle
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original full lobby screen concept for a three.js 3v3 hero brawler, exactly1386x1294 pixels (same near-square aspect as screenshot). Reference1 is the CURRENT LOBBY CAMERA / UI PLACEMENT ONLY: keep its steep top-down three-quarter camera (about58degrees), straight-on horizontal court rear edge, upright portrait UI strip down left, corner chips and clear open central area. Reference2 is the approved ink-and-watercolour world/sky style. Reference3 is the approved hand-inked painted card material, use for all UI. REPLACE schoolyard setting entirely with a modest floating training isle of ancient weighty chipped lavender-grey stone. A continuous broad plain flat stone floor, calm printed pale colour, no outlined flagstone grid, no floor cracks, no chalk, sand, chain-link, hopscotch, seaside props or holograms. Thin navy ink on stone silhouettes, sparse ink strata ONLY on vertical cliff faces; heavier navy ink on world objects, hero and UI. Flat buildable slabs/prisms/drums/leaf planes, softly aquarelle coloured sky and edge washes, economical geometry rather than busy illustration. Vast quiet sky, hefty weathered stone; charm with edge, not plush/chibi: no blush or glossy eyes, small stern eyes, notched ears/horns, bottom-heavy planted stance. No generic castle spires, magic sparkle shower or cyberpunk.
LAYOUT AND EXACT REQUIRED OBJECTS, readable without hunting:
1) Six team seats, EXACTLY THREE BLUE plus THREE RED, represented by low solid square stone plinths with small team banners (one banner per plinth), no glass or translucent seat ghosts. Like screenshot, blue plinths in a vertical/diagonal depth row at screen x~40%, red row at x~67%; the rows run screen y~32%,42%,52%. All six clearly countable, same scale, none hidden by UI. A SINGLE selected slim bark-and-bone ranger hero with three quiver arrows, angular pointed worn hood, small stern eyes, a blue team belt and stout boots stands on the rear blue plinth, all five other plinths EMPTY.
2) Central sparring spot behind/between seat rows, x~54%,y~24%: TWO freestanding sturdy sparring dummies of stone-and-bark, with plain circular shields (no red/blue on dummies), one low faded stone circular inlay beneath them, plenty of open floor for shooting and movement.
3) Three distinct interactable difficulty TARGET STONES in the foreground, x~39%,52%,65%, y~69%, all separated and facing camera. Easy = low broad chipped standing stone with ONE embossed lozenge; Normal = middle-height square shield stone with TWO embossed lozenges; Hard = taller horn-notched angular standing stone with THREE embossed lozenges. Neutral stone colours, never team blue/red or gold. Each on its own small physical stone base you can walk up to or shoot. Small legible hovering/live-text labels EXACTLY "EASY", "NORMAL", "HARD", directly below corresponding object. NO magnets, U-shapes, horseshoes, flat cardboard cutouts, buttons or cute faces.
4) Separate ready/start zone at lower right x~84%,y~69%: low stepped stone dais and a modest worn stone gate behind it, pale cream ready inlay on dais, readable small live-text sign EXACTLY "READY". Clearly within isle bounds and reachable along open floor from seat rows; not an off-island arch or a menu button. Must be distinct from difficulty targets.
UI: left edge vertical strip FOUR painted parchment hero cards, about10% screen width, screen y32..74%, with simple dark ink portraits/icons and live names EXACTLY "FLETCHER", "MITTS", "CAROM", "SKIP". Cream deckled paper, single wobbly ink rim, pale mineral watercolour title wash. Fletcher selected by slightly warmer wash only, no saturated diagonal sticker stripes, solid ink bands, bevels or hard geometric bezels. Small corner chips: back arrow and "PLAY ONLINE" top-left, fullscreen and sound icons top-right, small parchment Q W E chips bottom-centre. These UI elements float at screen edges and don't cover six seats or targets. No extra giant title or arbitrary panels.
COLOUR BUDGET: only team banners and hero team piece have saturated blue/red. Gold ONLY on an optional small practice Ball near sparring spot (no scenery gold). Cream/pale teal glows only, white waterfalls with lilac shade, never blue waterfalls. Plants only on outermost rim, never central court. Keep court clear, gently light, with masses legible at a glance. The training isle fills frame similarly to screenshot with its dark cliff visible along front and sky showing beyond upper edge and side corners. Do not turn into cinematic side-on horizon shot or giant dungeon, no camera rotation.
LIGHTING: DAY version. Court is flat butter-green/ivory stone, at least30% lighter than lavender-grey cliff sides; sky and warm peach cloud sea lightest. Floating smaller grassy pillars and one distant broken stone arch fade into the warm peach sky, big pale moon at upper-right distant, no face. A white ribbon waterfall off outer side edge, lilac shade; moss lip and a few apricot flowers only on rim. Printed ellipse shadows, warm light from upper-left. Painted hero card title washes warm sandstone/apricot. Quiet sunny air with real cliff mass and an immense drop, no candy look.
jobs.refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this existing lobby concept with two SMALL local art-direction corrections; preserve camera, crop, complete UI including all text, all object positions and proportions exactly. Keep EXACTLY3blue seat plinths and3red seat plinths, the one hero on back blue seat, two dummies, all3difficulty targets and ready gate/dais. The floor must be LINeless: remove ALL floor crack strokes, outlined stone grids, floor flecks and busy patchwork; make it one continuous plain printed warm butter-green ivory watercolour field with only very subtle low-contrast paper grain, preserving soft printed object shadows and the simple faded round stone sparring inlay. Do not remove contours from the upright objects or cliff rim; sparse strata and cracks on VERTICAL stone sides stay. No foliage or stones scattered in walking area. The two decorative blue banners on large rear rim stone walls at upper-left and upper-right must become neutral unmarked faded parchment/olive-gray banners, with NO saturated blue and NO team insignia. Keep the THREE actual blue seat banners and THREE actual red seat banners unchanged. All other colours, architecture, plants at rim, sky, UI, creature portraits, little skill chips and exact functional layout remain unchanged. No new props. Same near-square1386x1294 composition.
